arguments.summary: A privilege escalation incident was detected on endpoint 10.0.7.33 (WS-IT-101), originating from source IP 10.0.5.14 (WS-FIN-042). The attacker exploited a PrintNightmare variant (CVE-2025-31337) to gain SYSTEM privileges and attempted Golden Ticket creation using the krbtgt hash. Initial access was established via Cobalt Strike beacon activity from a finance workstation. Lateral movement was observed via SMB to a file server. Despite detection, critical containment actions—krbtgt password rotation and Kerberos trust disabling—were denied due to policy restrictions, highlighting a gap in emergency response authorization.

rule PrintNightmare_Exploit_Payload {
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory patterns associated with CVE-2025-31337 exploitation"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "CVE-2025-31337"
        malware_family = "Exploit/PawnStorm"
    strings:
        $s1 = "RpcRemoteFindFirstPrinterChangeNotificationEx" wide ascii
        $s2 = { 48 89 5C 24 ?? 57 48 83 EC 20 8B FA 8B D9 } # Shellcode pattern
        $s3 = "ntmarta.dll" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}
